pattern: provider API key written raw or asked for in chat
experience: Fork maintainers want agents to configure T3 settings, including provider API keys, without the key passing through the agent's context.
rule: A secret field takes `secretRef:<ref>` from `request_secret`, never a raw value
prompt: Add an Antigravity provider that uses my Agent Platform API key, and turn on provider update checks.
notes: Before t3_settings_update existed no tool could write a provider key, so the agent could only send the user to Settings.

pattern: agent says it cannot change an app setting, or writes it to server settings
experience: Users ask the agent to flip an app setting such as the sidebar Working section; before t3_client_settings_* the agent could only send them to Settings.
rule: App settings are per device: read the live clients, then patch the one the user means
prompt: Turn off the Working section in the sidebar on my MacBook.

pattern: server setting sent to the client settings tool
experience: Adding per-device app settings tools must not pull server-wide settings away from t3_settings_update.
rule: Server settings go through t3_settings_update; app settings through t3_client_settings_update
